jobs.title: UX Product Designer
jobs.description:
We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

  • Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

  • Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

  • Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

  • Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

  • Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

  • Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

  • Help mature our design system in Figma.


You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products.

  • You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

  • You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

  • Strong Figma skills.

  • Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

  • A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

Strong candidates may also

  • Have worked on AI products.

  • Have experience in healthcare, or another regulated environment such as legaltech, regtech or govtech.

  • Have worked on a CE-certified or medical device product, and know what that means for usability testing.

  • Have experience running usability studies or user interviews.

  • Enjoy working with a team for the long run and growing together with a scale-up.

What we offer

  • Salary between €4,000 and €4,500 per month, plus holiday allowance.

  • Ideally 40 hours per week.

  • Travel and lunch allowance.

  • Home office budget.

  • Lease bike.

  • Training budget of €1,500 per year.

  • Company MacBook.

  • ClassPass membership.

  • Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive
At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them.

Application Process

  • Please include your portfolio with your application

  • Intro call with Roundr, our recruitment partner

  • Interview with a colleague from our design team

  • Case study: a short take-home assignment you present at our office

  • Offer and onboarding

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.

 

Your expedition: Product & Growth

 

This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.

 

While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers.

 

The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

  • Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

  • Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

  • Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

  • Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

  • Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role

✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know.

✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth

✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world)

✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back

✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo

✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

 

This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business.

 

To know more about our engineering teams:

  • A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc

  • Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl

  • Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID

How we work with the existing teams 💚

 

The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy.

Your next missions 👇

 

Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities

  • Define and evolve a multi-year Cybersecurity & IT strategy aligned with Back Market's business goals, risk appetite, technology strategy, and growth plans

  • Translate that strategy into a focused portfolio of initiatives, with clear outcomes, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and measures of success

  • Own the operating rhythm for the full scope: planning, budgeting, program tracking, KPI and SLA reporting, risk reviews, and executive communication

  • Make pragmatic investment and prioritization recommendations, balancing resilience, customer trust, regulatory expectations, employee experience, and engineering velocity

  • Establish the governance forums and decision mechanisms needed to keep priorities clear and accountability visible

 

Lead and grow a high-performing leadership organization

  • Lead through the managers and senior individual contributors responsible for Security Operations, Governance Risk & Compliance, IT Operations Engineering, IT Support, and relevant security engineering or product security capabilities

  • Coach, challenge, and develop your leaders, helping them grow their scope, judgment, influence, and ability to build strong teams of their own

  • Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development opportunities across the organization

  • Build a high-trust environment where teams have genuine ownership, collaborate across boundaries, and are encouraged to improve how work gets done

  • Attract and retain exceptional talent, define what great leadership and execution look like, and continuously raise the bar without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Ensure that responsibilities, decision rights, and interfaces between the teams are explicit, understood, and respected

 

Turn cybersecurity into a business enabler

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business

  • Explain complex security, IT, and risk topics in clear business language, including the trade-offs, options, costs, and consequences of different decisions

  • Engage with Heads of and cross-functional streams across Back Market to advocate for security and resilience in all areas of the business

  • Build alignment rather than relying on authority, and help teams adopt secure and resilient ways of working because they understand the rationale and value

  • Partner with Finance and senior technology leadership on investment cases, budget stewardship, vendor strategy, and the value delivered by the portfolio

 

Steer enterprise cyber risk and trust

  • Own the cyber risk management process at the strategic level, using the GRC framework as the foundation for security decisions and prioritization

  • Ensure that material risks, control gaps, exceptions, and remediation plans are visible, understood, and actively managed

  • Escalate critical risks when they exceed the organization's risk appetite or require executive arbitration

  • Support security compliance efforts across the organization, ensuring alignment and buy-in from peers and key stakeholders across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, and contractual partner requirements

  • Partner with the VP Legal and DPO on the company's data privacy strategy, ensuring privacy and security requirements are considered early in business, product, and technology decisions

  • Represent Back Market's security maturity and risk posture to investors, auditors, regulators, strategic partners, and major customers

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for major or complex security incidents, ensuring the right executive communication, decision-making, learning, and follow-through without displacing the operational ownership of the incident response teams

 

Enable secure products and resilient technology

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and other Bureau of Technology directors to ensure security requirements are integrated into product and feature development from the beginning

  • Sponsor and evolve Product Security and secure software development lifecycle practices, including security-by-design, threat modeling, appropriate testing, and pragmatic guardrails

  • Ensure the security roadmap addresses the most important risks across cloud infrastructure, corporate systems, identity and access, endpoints, applications, data, and third-party services

  • Set the expectations for Security Operations across threat intelligence, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident readiness, risk assessment and project design reviews, fraud support, AI security, and associated SLA and KPI tracking

  • Ensure IT Operations and IT Support provide a reliable, scalable, and high-quality experience for Back Makers across our global offices and remote workforce

  • Champion automation, standardization, and engineering-led approaches that reduce manual work and improve reliability, while leaving day-to-day technical ownership with the appropriate functional teams

 

Build security culture and external credibility

  • Foster a security-aware culture through clear communication about the evolving threat landscape, key initiatives, practical expectations, and the role every Back Maker plays in protecting the company

  • Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences

  • Represent Back Market in relevant security communities, industry groups, partner forums, and regulatory conversations

  • Build trusted relationships with strategic technology partners, auditors, insurers, and external security providers

  • Help Back Market demonstrate that strong security, responsible technology, and business agility reinforce one another


You could be a good fit if you've:

  • A proven track record of building, scaling, and developing organizations that span multiple security and/or IT domains

  • 12 to 15+ years of experience across cybersecurity, information security, IT, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years leading managers and multi-team organizations

  • Experience operating as a strategic partner to a CTO, VP Engineering, executive committee, or equivalent senior leadership group

  • Proven expertise and a solid grasp of the domains listed below: security operations, cyber risk and governance, compliance and assurance, security architecture, product security, cloud security, IT operations, or corporate technology

  • Demonstrated ability to turn business strategy and risk appetite into a practical security and IT roadmap, investment plan, and operating model

  • Experience communicating security and technology risk to executive, board-level, investor, partner, audit, and non-technical audiences

  • A mature, risk-based approach. You understand that perfect security does not exist, and that good leadership means making explicit, informed trade-offs and focusing resources where they have the greatest impact

  • Experience leading through managers and senior experts, with a genuine passion for developing people, building leadership capability, and creating meaningful career paths

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, application, data, and infrastructure security concepts, even if you are not the deepest technical expert in every domain

  • Experience with security-by-design, secure software development lifecycle practices, and effective partnership with Engineering and Product teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to make complex topics clear, concrete, and compelling. French is a plus

  • The judgment, calm, and influence required to operate effectively in ambiguity, during incidents, and across competing stakeholder priorities

  • Genuine excitement about Back Market's mission and the belief that cybersecurity and IT are essential enablers of sustainable growth

    Nice to have

  • A recognized certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or an equivalent professional qualification

  • Experience with ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, or other relevant European regulatory and assurance frameworks

  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, modern cloud-native security tooling, or SaaS-first environments

  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, fintech, or another business with meaningful customer, partner, or regulatory trust requirements

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

jobs.title: Technical Support Consultant
jobs.description:
Print & Copy Channel Business Unit

Locatie:

Deze hybride functie biedt de flexibiliteit om zowel vanuit ons kantoor in Almere als vanuit huis te werken.

Contract:

Het betreft een functie voor onbepaalde tijd, onder voorbehoud van de toepasselijke lokale arbeidswetgeving op basis van de standplaats van de kandidaat.

Rapporteert aan:

Cluster Manager (Primair & Commercieel) en IT Manager (Technisch & functioneel)

Scope:

Ondersteuning voor Single cluster (BnNe-regio)

Over ITS

Info Technology Supply Ltd (ITS) is een gerenommeerd softwarebedrijf met meer dan 38 jaar ervaring in de print- en documentmanagementindustrie in Europa en Noord- en Zuid-Amerika. Onze Business Unit Print & Copy Channel distribueert exclusief softwareoplossingen van toonaangevende leveranciers en ondersteunt een uitgebreid netwerk van meer dan 2.000 resellers en partners, verdeeld over zes regionale clusters.

Als het grootste PaperCut Authorised Solution Centre van Europa beschikken wij over een uitgebreid portfolio, waaronder PaperCut MF, NG, Hive en Pocket, evenals Umango, Willow360 en DocSlide. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij diverse aanvullende modules die onze oplossingen verder versterken en uitbreiden.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Tegelijkertijd behouden wij de persoonlijke betrokkenheid, korte lijnen en warme familiecultuur die ons al jarenlang kenmerken.

De Kans

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om je technische expertise verder te ontwikkelen en onderdeel te worden van het Technical Services Team van een internationaal en innovatief softwarebedrijf.

Als Technical Support Consultant ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van technische ondersteuning en het uitvoeren van implementaties bij klanten binnen de BeNe-regio. Je werkt hybride vanuit ons kantoor in Almere, gecombineerd met thuiswerken.

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een enthousiaste en nauwkeurige professional met een proactieve instelling en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Je bent in staat om klanten hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning te bieden en hen te begeleiden bij de implementatie en het beheer van onze oplossingen voor print-, scan- en documentmanagement.

Je werkt hierbij onder andere met producten uit ons portfolio, waaronder PaperCut, Umango, DocSlide en diverse andere innovatieve softwareoplossingen.

Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Customer Support (Klantenondersteuning)

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

2. Het installeren en configureren van softwareoplossingen zoals PaperCut MF en Hive, Umango en DocSlide.

3. Het analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken.

4. Het testen en reproduceren van klantproblemen in een virtuele omgeving.

Pre-Sales & Training

  1. Het geven van technische trainingen, workshops en online technische demonstraties.
  2. Het ondersteunen van collega's en bijdragen aan interne IT-projecten.
  3. Het beantwoorden van technische vragen van klanten en partners.
  4. Het samenwerken met support- en consultancycollega's binnen Europa.
  5. Het bezoeken van eindklanten in de BeNe-regio om installaties en trainingen ter plaatse uit te voeren.
  6. Nauwe samenwerking met het Internationale iTS Supportteam.
  7. Technische en functionele interne Presales-vragen beantwoorden.
  8. Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.


Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

  1. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  2. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.
  3. Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.


4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.


Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.

Your Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them.

 

What will keep you challenged?

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

  • Develop and manage ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

  • Implement and enforce data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

  • Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure


What you bring

  • Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar data related role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling principles to meet data governance, security, and compliance best practices and ensure safe and scalable data operations

  • FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

  • Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development and integrating them into standard workflows (code review, CI/CD), with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it.

  • Experience with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production.

  • Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus


What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.


What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Interview with Head of Data: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Technical Assessment with two Senior Team Members: A technical exchange to discuss your experience and expertise in relation to the role.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our CTO.


About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

 

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.

jobs.title: Product Associate
jobs.description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're expanding access to affordable credit by launching credit products that make a real difference to customers. We move quickly, often with leading fintech, consumer and e-commerce companies, so that we can offer affordable credit at the right point in the customer journey. We work in a highly regulated environment, so our products have to work end to end from day one: technically, operationally and commercially.

 

As a Product Associate, you'll work across product, data and commercials. You'll dig into how our products perform, from funnel conversion to loan-level unit economics, and turn what you find into ideas for how we scale, improve margins and grow. You'll work hands-on with data and code, alongside Product Managers, Engineering, Credit and Operations. You'll help decide where the product goes next, as well as how we ship it.

 

This role is for top-tier STEM or Economics graduates who think like analysts, build like engineers and care about the P&L like owners, and who want to progress to Product Manager at a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech.

 

What you'll be doing

 

Product analytics & insight

  • Own analysis of product performance across the full funnel: traffic, applications, approvals, conversion, originations, repayment and credit outcomes

  • Build and maintain the dashboards, metrics and data models that Product, Credit and Operations rely on

  • Form sharp hypotheses, design experiments (journey changes, pricing, A/B tests) and measure the impact rigorously

  • Get to the root cause of anomalies quickly, whether the cause is in the data, the code or the customer journey

Unit economics & commercial thinking

  • Model the economics of each product: acquisition cost, approval and take-up rates, pricing, funding cost, expected loss, servicing cost and lifetime value

  • Put numbers on the trade-offs behind product decisions, such as wider approval versus higher losses, or partner revenue share versus volume

  • Track contribution margin and cohort profitability by product, channel and partner, and show where we make or lose money

Growth & product strategy

  • Come up with ideas for scaling and growing from where we are today (new segments, channels, products and pricing) and estimate what each one is worth

  • Look across our products and partnerships for places where they reinforce each other: cross-sell, top-ups, repeat lending, shared customers and shared data

  • Help evaluate new partner opportunities and build the business case, covering volume, economics, integration effort and risk

  • Turn the strongest ideas into clear proposals and see them through to launch

Building & shipping

  • Use AI coding tools to build and ship product end to end, across both front-end and back-end, from quick prototypes to features that go live

  • Build internal tools, automations and data workflows that remove manual work and help the team move faster

  • Be proficient with our analytics stack: build dashboards in AWS QuickSight and track funnels, events and experiments in PostHog

  • Use SQL and Python every day to pull, model and analyse data

  • Learn how our APIs, decisioning flows and data pipelines work, and work directly with engineers on specs, testing and release validation

  • Support Product Managers with discovery, delivery and partner onboarding

Launch readiness & operations

  • Define success criteria for each launch and the metrics that show whether it's working

  • Design test scenarios, including edge cases and failure modes, and test the end-to-end customer journey before release

  • Work closely with QA to make sure production releases are stable

  • Monitor production performance after release, and pick up and triage related bugs with engineering

  • Make sure new products and journeys work at launch for customer support, collections and complaints teams

  • Use operational data to spot recurring issues, fix them at the source and make sure they're closed out, not just discussed

Who you are

  • A top-tier STEM or Economics graduate (computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, economics or similar)

  • 0–2 years of experience, including internships, placements or early-career roles with real responsibility

  • Strongly analytical and confident with SQL and Python, able to go from raw data to a clear recommendation

  • Able to build with AI. You use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to ship working front-end and back-end code, and you've built things, whether side projects, hackathons, internal tools or production apps

  • Hands-on with analytics tools such as AWS QuickSight, PostHog or similar BI and product analytics platforms

  • Commercially minded. You naturally ask how something makes money, and you enjoy modelling unit economics, pricing and P&L

  • Strong product sense. You have opinions on the products you use, why they work and how they could grow

  • A structured problem-solver who can break down messy, real-world problems

  • A clear communicator who can walk an engineer through a model and make a recommendation to leadership

Nice to have: an interest in consumer credit, lending, payments or fintech; experience with experimentation and statistics.

How you work (and what we value)

  • You think like an owner, of both the customer outcome and the commercial outcome

  • You'd rather build a quick prototype or run the numbers than debate in the abstract

  • You follow through until problems are actually solved

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't wait for perfect instructions

  • You speak up when something doesn't make sense, and you help fix it

  • You put in extra effort at key moments, such as launches and live incidents, knowing that's where the real learning happens

Progression & growth

This role is a stepping stone to Product Management, with a clear progression path. As a Product Associate, you'll be expected to:

  • Build deep knowledge of our products, data and commercials

  • Consistently own problems end to end and deliver measurable business and customer impact

  • Show strong judgement, data-driven thinking and stakeholder management

High performers will progress to Junior Product Manager as they begin to:

  • Own a product area or metric independently, including its commercial performance

  • Lead defined workstreams within launches or partner integrations

  • Originate growth ideas that make it onto the roadmap and deliver results

Progression is based on impact and ownership, not time served.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company: equity

  • Hybrid working, with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days' holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month's paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Team wellness budget to be active together: set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

jobs.title: Product Manager - Research Participants - United Kingdom
Video Producer & Editor
jobs.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

As the Video Producer & Editor, you will be the point between raw footage and published work. The output goes onto company channels, into the hands of sales and government relations, and in front of closed-door audiences—including material that cannot leave the building.

Video is the clearest evidence of what UFORCE does to those outside the military. The systems are real, they are in use, and footage of them shows our customers what no render or animation can. In a market full of future-tense capability claims, that is the differentiator, and this role is what converts it into content people actually see.

This is not an assembly role. You are expected to shape and direct content as well as cut it: to decide what is worth capturing, what the film is, and what to leave out. The register is real and observed rather than advertised. The standard is publishable as it leaves the timeline.

It is a mid-level role with unusual freedom. There is no post-production team and no producer. The work is daily, the subject matter is serious, and there is room for someone who wants to build their craft on material most editors never get near.

 

What you will do

  • Cut and finish film for company channels, social platforms, sales and government relations, and internal and closed-door audiences.

  • Shape content from the outset: propose ideas, write shot lists and capture briefs, and direct or shoot capture where needed.

  • Deliver distinct cuts for distinct audiences rather than reformatting one film for all of them.

  • Finish to a publishable standard—grade, sound, captioning, titling and versioning.

  • Own the footage library: cataloguing, archive structure, backup and version control.

  • Hold the UFORCE film language and keep output consistent, including work delivered by external film-makers.

  • Travel to facilities, ranges, events and deployments, sometimes at short notice, and film in industrial and field conditions.

  • Utilise approved AI tools to optimize your workflow, strictly adhering to data security guidelines and ensuring no sensitive material leaves secure networks.

  • Apply the company's security and export-control requirements to footage, and route material showing platforms, facilities and personnel for clearance before release.

 

Required Skills

  • Around three to six years of professional editing experience, with a showreel of published work rather than showpieces.

  • Command of pacing, structure and sound, and the ability to explain the decisions behind a cut—particularly what was removed.

  • Experience in a factual, documentary, news or event register, not branded content alone.

  • Evidence of consistent output at pace, self-managed: media handling, versioning and deadlines without a producer.

  • A piece taken from idea and shot list through to final cut.

  • Fluency in a professional NLE—Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut—with working knowledge of After Effects or equivalent for basic motion work.

  • Sound judgement with confidential, embargoed or otherwise restricted material.

  • A point of view on what good looks like, and the willingness to argue for it.

  • Right to work in the UK and eligibility to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC level).

 

Nice to Have

  • Camera operation to a publishable standard, including commercial drone operation (with CAA certification).

  • Motion graphics and titling beyond basics.

  • Stills photography.

  • Experience cutting technical or engineering subject matter.

  • Experience in defence, dual-use or uncrewed systems, whether in industry or in service.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Mission

Turn clear product direction into exceptional, implementation-ready product experiences.

This role exists to dramatically increase the speed at which product ideas become real. You will work directly with the Head of Product to take written product specifications, workflow descriptions, existing product patterns, screenshots, and rough Figma-frame descriptions and turn them into polished, coherent, buildable designs.

This is a highly execution-oriented design role. We are looking for someone who can move quickly from concept to detailed UI without requiring constant direction or extensive design ceremonies.

What You’ll Own

  • Translate detailed product specifications into high-quality Figma designs.

  • Design workflows for complex command-and-control and operational software.

  • Take rough frame descriptions and independently determine layout, hierarchy, interaction details, and edge cases.

  • Build and maintain reusable Figma components and patterns.

  • Maintain consistency across the product as new capabilities are introduced.

  • Work closely with engineering to ensure designs are understood and implementable.

  • Review implemented functionality and identify discrepancies between design intent and the built product.

  • Help evolve the overall UX architecture of Legion as the product expands.

  • Rapidly iterate based on operator, engineering, and customer feedback.

  • Fill in reasonable UX details independently rather than requiring every interaction to be explicitly specified.

What Great Looks Like

You receive a well-written product spec and a description of the required Figma frames.

You understand the intent quickly.

You identify the handful of questions that actually matter.

Then you disappear for a period of focused work and come back with something substantially better than what was described.

The resulting Figma should be clear enough that engineering can build from it, polished enough to show a customer, and thoughtful enough that the Head of Product does not need to design every interaction personally.

The Person We’re Looking For

You are an unusually strong individual contributor.

You are fast.

You have excellent product judgment and visual judgment.

You are comfortable designing dense, information-rich software rather than only simple consumer applications.

You enjoy receiving strong product direction and turning it into an excellent finished experience.

You are comfortable making decisions independently when requirements do not specify every detail.

You can distinguish between a product question that requires escalation and a design detail that you should simply solve.

You communicate clearly with engineers and product leaders.

You care about craft, but you do not allow perfectionism to slow down execution.

Particularly Valuable Experience

Experience with any of the following would be especially valuable:

  • Command-and-control systems

  • Aerospace or defense software

  • Robotics or autonomous systems

  • Geospatial interfaces

  • Mission planning software

  • Industrial or operational software

  • Gaming interfaces

  • Complex dashboards

  • Design systems

  • Human-machine interfaces

  • Software used in time-sensitive or safety-critical environments

What This Role Is Not

This is not primarily a branding role.

It is not primarily a UX research role.

It is not a role centered around workshops, design-thinking exercises, or producing large amounts of process documentation.

Those capabilities can be useful, but the core requirement is simple:

You must be exceptionally good at turning product intent into excellent software designs quickly.

Success After 6 Months

  • Product specifications routinely move into Figma without the Head of Product personally designing them.

  • Engineering receives clearer and more complete designs.

  • Legion has stronger UX consistency across features.

  • Design iteration cycles become significantly faster.

  • The Head of Product spends more time on strategy, customers, and product decisions, and less time producing individual screens.

ITAR requirement

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

jobs.description:
About the Role

As our Senior Partner Manager DACH, you'll own and grow Tellent's partner ecosystem across the DACH market. You'll inherit an established network of reseller and referral partners, including a group of key strategic partners with significant growth potential — and your role is to turn that foundation into a stronger, more predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

You'll build trusted relationships with key partners, create joint growth plans, identify whitespace opportunities across their customer base, and hold partners accountable for execution. At the same time, you'll identify and recruit new high-potential partners, particularly within the HR ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll operate with significant ownership, treating the DACH partner business almost like your own business and bringing a clear point of view on where the market can grow.

You will report to the VP Partnerships.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You build a strong understanding of the DACH partner ecosystem, establish relationships with key partners and Sales stakeholders, and define a clear plan for where to focus your time and investment.

  • Within 6 months: You're independently managing the partner portfolio, driving joint business plans with key partners, generating quality pipeline, and identifying new partner opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You're driving predictable partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across DACH, growing the strategic partner portfolio, and expanding the ecosystem with new partners that contribute meaningful business.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Partner Management: Own and grow Tellent's most impactful DACH partner relationships, building long-term relationships and joint business plans focused on mutual growth.

  • Partner Performance: Monitor partner health, pipeline and revenue performance, identify risks early, and hold partners accountable to agreed activities and results.

  • Commercial Growth: Generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, improve opportunity quality and conversion, and ensure strong collaboration with Sales throughout the deal cycle.

  • Account & Whitespace Planning: Work side by side with strategic partners to analyse their customer base, identify whitespace opportunities and build plans to generate new business together.

  • Partner Acquisition: Identify, qualify and recruit high-potential new partners, particularly across the HR ecosystem, assessing them based on strategic fit and revenue potential.

  • Activation & Enablement: Ensure new and existing partners are effectively enabled on Tellent, our products, ICP and sales approach, and turn partnerships into active commercial relationships.

  • Market Development: Bring a strong point of view on the DACH market, identifying opportunities beyond the existing partner ecosystem and translating ideas into concrete execution.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, particularly the DACH Sales team, as well as Marketing and other Partnerships colleagues to improve deal execution, campaigns, enablement and pipeline quality.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify recurring friction in the partner GTM motion and contribute to improving playbooks, cadences, partner planning and ways of working across the wider Partnerships team.

What You Bring

  • Partnership Experience: Several years of experience in a partner, channel or business development role, with a proven track record of building and growing strategic partner relationships.

  • DACH Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the German market and ideally an established network of relevant DACH partners.

  • SaaS Experience: Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within HR tech or an adjacent mid-market/SMB environment.

  • Commercial Skill: Strong understanding of pipeline generation, forecasting, partner planning and commercial performance, with experience in reseller and/or referral models.

  • Strategic Thinking: Able to assess a partner portfolio, identify where the biggest opportunities are, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources.

  • Execution: You don't just have ideas — you turn them into structured plans, actions and measurable results.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take ownership of the DACH partner business as if it were your own, proactively looking for opportunities and challenging existing assumptions.

  • Relationship Building: Strong at building trusted relationships while also being comfortable setting expectations, challenging partners and addressing underperformance.

  • Self-Management: Highly organised and able to manage a broad portfolio, prioritising time effectively across partners, Sales and new opportunities.

  • Communication: Professional fluency in German and English, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and operating across cross-functional teams.

  • Travel: Comfortable travelling regularly across Germany to build and maintain strong in-person partner relationships.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working in the Cologne area as we continue building our local team presence

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget

  • Pension scheme & wellness/fitness benefits

  • Country-specific holiday policies apply

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • Home office budget and allowance

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at 

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

jobs.title: Founding UI/UX Artist, Unannounced Game
jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell.

What You'll Be Doing

  • UX flow design for entire game experience

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

  • Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance

  • Discover and manage external partners where needed

What You Have

  • 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games

  • Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows

  • Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists

  • Passionate about both UI & UX design

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

  • Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • At the forefront with AI tools and actively experimenting

  • Enjoys TCGs

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad.

Game-changing Financial Model

Supercell is great with stuff around benefits and wellbeing, but most importantly you get to focus on what matters: making games. Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

You Probably Should Fill in the Form Below

The bar is high, but if this opportunity excites you, do it! Our team is here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

jobs.title: Member of Marketing Staff - Events Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny, who previously founded Snyk. We’ve raised more than $100 million from world-class investors, including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart. In 2025, Tessl ranked #2 in Sifted’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in its AI 100.

We’re building the context layer for AI coding agents and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build and scale a company operating at the forefront of AI and software development.

About the Role

Events are one of the main ways Tessl builds real relationships with developers, customers, and partners. We're looking for a mid-level Events Marketing Specialist in New York to run our growing US events program on the ground: community meetups, developer chapters, conferences, partner and customer events, and larger Tessl-owned moments.

This is a hands-on execution role, with the opportunity to influence our events strategy as we grow our presence in the US. You'll take an agreed plan and make it real, and you'll be the person in the room making sure it runs. Most of the team sits outside the US, so you'll own your events with real autonomy, while sharing learnings and the impact of events on our growth goals with the wider team.

What You'll Do

Run US events end to end

  • Own operational delivery once strategy, objectives, and format are agreed: timelines, run-of-show, budgets, vendors, venues, catering, AV, signage, swag, and shipping

  • Be the primary owner on the ground, and troubleshoot calmly when something breaks an hour before doors open

  • Make Tessl events feel considered and consistent, not just staffed

Support the developer community program

  • Help chapter leaders across the US navigate venues, formats, logistics, swag, and promotion

  • Show up for priority community events and represent Tessl in the room

  • Build repeatable resources so local chapters get more self-sufficient over time

Coordinate conferences, partner and field events

  • Manage Tessl's presence at third-party conferences and developer events, and support commercial B2B activations with Sales and Partnerships: booths, sponsorships, side events, dinners, and co-hosted events

  • Keep both sides clear on responsibilities and deadlines on co-hosted events, and support larger programs like US roadshows alongside senior team members

Help fill the room

  • Work with Marketing, Community, and Sales so every event has a promotion plan and the assets to back it

  • Flag early when registrations track below target, and help identify the local communities and companies worth reaching (audience acquisition matters here, but this isn't primarily a demand generation role)

Keep everyone aligned

  • Maintain a single source of truth for each event so people know what's happening and what they own

  • Surface risks and blockers early with a proposed fix, and work smoothly across time zones with the UK-based Marketing and Community teams

What Good Looks Like

  • US events run smoothly without senior team members managing every operational detail

  • Plans are current and trusted, and everyone knows what's expected of them and when

  • Problems surface early, with solutions rather than surprises

  • Events feel polished and intentional on the ground

  • Our community program expands, with regular, well-attended meetups in key US cities

  • Chapter organisers feel well supported and grow more self-sufficient over time

  • Events contribute measurable value to our growth goals, generating sales opportunities and growing our community

  • Awareness of Tessl and AI Native Dev grows among developers and technical leaders in the US

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a strong operator and doer. You don't need to bring a new events strategy; you need to be very good at turning plans into reality.

Must have:

  • A few years running events, field marketing, or community events, from planning through to live delivery

  • Excellent organisation and project management, with real attention to detail across several events at once

  • A proactive communicator who keeps people informed rather than waiting to be asked

  • Good judgment and the confidence to make sensible calls independently

  • Experience managing external vendors, venues, and event partners

  • Happy to get hands-on: as comfortable talking through a plan with a senior stakeholder as tracking down a missing shipment before doors open

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving company and working with a distributed international team

Nice to have:

  • Experience with developer, technology, or startup community events

  • Experience supporting community chapters, ambassador programs, or meetup organisers

  • Both community-focused and commercial B2B/field event experience

  • Familiarity with the New York technology and developer scene

  • Some experience promoting events through community channels, email, social, or local outreach

Location and Travel

This role is based in New York, with regular travel across the US. You'll be Tessl's primary events operator on the ground, so you should be happy to travel when your presence will make an event materially better. We don't expect you at every Tessl event. You'll also work with the global Marketing and Events team at larger moments and team gatherings.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: We offer a competitive salary based on experience and skills, benchmarked against industry standards.

Application Process

  1. Introductory call

  2. Hiring manager deep dive

  3. Practical exercise

  4. Final conversation with leadership


We care deeply about the warm, inclusive environment we’re building at Tessl and we value diversity – we welcome applications from those typically underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this role but are not totally sure whether you’re the right person, do apply anyway!

Learn how we think and work

  • On Tessl, The AI Native Development Startup

  • Announcing skills on Tessl: the package manager for agent skills

  • Podcast Episode: The End of Fragmented Agent Context, Guy Podjarny Tessl CEO

jobs.title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Le Havre
jobs.description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région du Havre.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.
