jobs.title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
jobs.description:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen.

Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin;

  • Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen;

  • Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming;

  • Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen;

  • Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten;

  • Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders;

  • Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements;

  • Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen.

Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwd ontwerp- en implementatievoorstel waarmee gebruikers sneller en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen op het gebied van resourceplanning en machinebezetting.


WIJ VRAGEN

  • HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van UI/UX Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Technology of vergelijkbaar.

WIJ BIEDEN

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

jobs.title: Learning Experience Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the role:

As a Learning Experience Architect at Quantum Systems, you will work with our Training & Demo Team to shape learning around our unmanned systems (UxS). You will help our international customers and employees understand complex technology and use it safely.

You will define the instructional approach for our training portfolio and support its implementation. Working with trainers and subject matter experts, you will digitize and scale existing training and develop new offerings. You will combine digital learning with practical exercises and assess how well learners can apply what they have learned.

You will have the freedom to take your ideas from concept to launch and put your own stamp on UxS training at Quantum Systems. Your work will improve the technical and instructional quality of our training and make its impact measurable.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • You will design modular learning paths that combine digital self-study with instructor-led training and simulator exercises.

  • You will turn technical expertise into interactive learning modules and assessments and coordinate media production.

  • You will build scalable offerings in learning management systems such as Moodle and define standards for quality and reusable content.

  • You will test learning concepts with target users and improve them using feedback, usage data and learning results.

  • You will evaluate learning outcomes and practical application and use the findings to improve our training portfolio.

  • You will advise and support our trainers in using effective instructional methods for digital and blended learning.

  • You will prioritize portfolio improvements and deliver learning projects with UxS experts, the Simulator Team and external providers.

  • You will analyze learning needs and define measurable objectives for new and existing offerings with the Training & Demo Team.



What you bring to the team:

  • You have a degree in education, instructional design, media or e-learning, or a comparable qualification with relevant practical experience.

  • You have solid experience in adult learning and modular, digital and blended learning, demonstrated through project examples or a portfolio.

  • You can analyze learning needs, define measurable objectives and test learning concepts with target users.

  • You are proficient in authoring tools and experienced in designing and publishing digital learning in learning management systems such as Moodle.

Sonar is scaling its go-to-market engine across Sales, Customer Success, and post-sales teams in every region. As the company grows, the field needs operating changes that are consistent, measurable, and adopted, not a collection of regional fixes. This role exists to design, land, and measure those changes.

As Director, Global Field Operations, you will sit in Revenue Operations as an individual contributor at Principal level, dedicated 100% to global field operations initiatives. You will not carry a regional support remit. You will own the portfolio of initiatives that change how the global field plans, sells, forecasts, and retains customers, from problem definition through rollout to measured business impact.   • Paid Search (SEA) - bezahlte Sichtbarkeit in Google & Co.

Das ist der vertikale Strich im „T". Gleichzeitig bringen wir dir bei, wie das gesamte digitale Marketing-Ökosystem zusammenspielt (der horizontale Strich) – denn die spannendsten Ergebnisse entstehen genau dort, wo die Kanäle ineinandergreifen. Du lernst nicht nur, wie man Knöpfe in Werbekonten oder Tools drückt. Wir machen dich zum strategischen Berater, der versteht, wie messbarer Impact und echter Umsatz für Unternehmen generiert werden.

jobs.title: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge
jobs.description:
Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge

Location: Cambridge (UK), hybrid with up to 2 remote days per week

Team: Product

Start date: ASAP

About Neural Concept

Neural Concept is the engineering intelligence platform used by leading manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, and energy. We combine geometric and physics AI with LLM-based agents so engineering teams can move from customer requirements to validated designs in a fraction of the usual time.

About the role

Design decisions depend on information that lives outside the CAD model: customer requirements, design rules, manufacturing and assembly constraints, and cost targets. This information is spread across specification documents, handbooks, ERP systems, requirements management tools, and system models. Engineers gather it by hand, often late in the process, and conflicts surface at design reviews or on the production line.

We call the capability that closes this gap Design Engineering Knowledge. It connects the design to the information ecosystem around it, so requirements, constraints, and trade-offs are available to engineers and AI agents while they work on the design itself.

As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives.

You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production.

What you will do

  • Build the requirements foundation: ingest customer specifications and RFQ packages, extract requirements with LLM and agent-based pipelines, and keep each one traceable to its source document and page.

  • Extend this foundation to design rules, DfM, DfA, and Design for Cost, turning standards, handbooks, and company know-how into constraints that software and agents can use.

  • Bring requirements, constraints, and trade-offs into the design workflow, so engineers can check a design against them at any stage and see which ones apply to the part they are working on.

  • Build integrations with the systems around the design: requirements management systems, ERP (cost, materials, and supplier data), and system design and MBSE tools for architecture and system-level requirements.

  • Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results.

  • Create evaluation sets and quality metrics with customers, so extraction and checking accuracy is measured and improves with every release.

  • Design human-in-the-loop review flows where engineers validate and edit AI output, with versioning and a full audit trail.

  • Spot recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable components of the Neural Concept platform.

Who you are

Must have

  • Experience building and shipping production Python software in fast-moving, cross-functional teams.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM applications in production: structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and evaluation.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems through APIs and data models, for example ERP, PLM, or requirements management tools.

  • Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing, OCR, or information extraction.

  • Strong software practices: testing (pytest), CI, packaging, code review, and git.

  • A product mindset. You talk to users, understand the problem before writing code, and ship in small, measurable steps.

  • Clear, concise communication with both customer engineers and internal teams.

  • Based in Cambridge (UK) or willing to relocate.

Nice to have

  • Background in mechanical engineering or physics, with exposure to DfM, DfA, or design-to-cost practices.

  • Familiarity with requirements engineering and model-based systems engineering (MBSE, SysML).

  • Experience working with CAD data or geometry processing.

  • Experience with vision-language models, vector databases, or search ranking.

What you get

  • Ownership of a product capability that customers use in real engineering programs, with direct access to the engineers who use it.

  • A competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • A collaborative, multicultural team where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Colleagues who share knowledge freely and support each other.

  • A hybrid model and flexible hours. We focus on results and trust you to organize your time.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers.

Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes:

  • Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet

  • Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes

  • Kubernetes clusters and managed databases

  • A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps

All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs.

What you'll own

You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill.

  • Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses.

  • Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity.

  • Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades.

  • Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap.

  • Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps.

  • Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems.

  • Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet.

  • Cost management: billing exports, budgets and alerts, tagging, a monthly cost review and commitment planning.

  • Developer enablement: templates, preview environments, documentation and support for the engineers who ship on the platform.

Our stack

Kubernetes: GKE, EKS, Helm, Ingress and Gateway API, autoscaling, RBAC, network policies

Networking: TCP/IP, subnets and CIDR, routing, NAT, L4 and L7 load balancers, DNS, TLS, firewalls, VPC peering

Google Cloud: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, IAM, Cloud Monitoring, billing export to BigQuery

Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi

CI/CD and containers: Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Argo CD, Docker and BuildKit, container registries

Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, CloudWatch, Alibaba CloudMonitor

Linux: Systems administration, systemd, disks and filesystems, performance debugging

Alibaba Cloud: ECS, VPC, NLB and ALB, ESSD disks, RDS, PolarDB, SAE, Cloud Firewall

AWS: EC2, EKS, RDS, ALB and NLB, Route 53, S3, Organizations

Cloudflare: DNS, Workers, Tunnels, WAF and rate limiting, Zero Trust

Databases (operations): PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, managed Kafka

Blockchain nodes: CometBFT-based chains, reth and other EVM clients, P2P networking

Vercel: Projects, builds, ISR, team access

Confidential computing: Intel TDX virtual machines on Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud

Must-haves

  • We want 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform roles, including 3+ years running production Kubernetes and owning CI/CD pipelines.

Kubernetes, in depth

  • Upgrading control planes and node pools with no downtime, and keeping clusters on supported versions.

  • Scheduling: requests and limits, affinity, taints and tolerations, priority, and eviction under node pressure.

  • Autoscaling with the HPA, cluster autoscaler or Karpenter, plus Spot or preemptible node pools for non-critical work.

  • Networking inside the cluster: CNI, Services, Ingress or Gateway API, network policies, and DNS within the cluster.

  • Security: RBAC, Pod Security, workload identity, and secrets that never sit in plain environment variables.

  • Stateful workloads: StatefulSets, persistent volumes and CSI drivers, and backup and restore.

  • Packaging and delivery with Helm or Kustomize, ideally through GitOps with Argo CD or Flux.

  • Debugging a failing pod, node or rollout from events, logs and metrics.

CI/CD, in depth

  • Pipeline design: you have built and run production CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Tekton). Pipelines are defined as code in a Jenkinsfile or workflow YAML, with shared libraries and reusable templates.

  • CI platform operations: running Jenkins controllers with ephemeral agents on Kubernetes, or self-hosted runners. That includes plugin and version upgrades, credential handling, and scaling build capacity.

  • Build pipelines: multi-service and monorepo builds with caching and parallel stages, and versioned artifacts. Container images built with Docker, BuildKit or Kaniko, including multi-architecture images, image scanning, SBOMs and signing.

  • Deployment pipelines: promotion from dev to staging to production with approvals and quality gates, plus blue-green, canary and fast rollback. GitOps with Argo CD or Flux, and database migrations as part of a release.

  • Infrastructure pipelines: Terraform or Pulumi plan and apply from CI, with policy checks and drift detection.

  • Pipeline security: short-lived credentials through OIDC federation or a secrets vault instead of long-lived keys, least-privilege deploy roles, and protected branches.

  • Release engineering for our chain: building and publishing node binaries and images, and coordinating rolling upgrades across validator and RPC fleets.

  • Delivery health: you track build time, build cost, flaky tests and DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore), and you cut wasted builds with ignore rules and caching.

Networking fundamentals

  • TCP/IP, subnetting and CIDR, routing, NAT, and the difference between L4 and L7 load balancing.

  • DNS, TLS and certificates, firewalls and security groups.

  • Private connectivity: VPC design, peering, private endpoints, and keeping internal traffic off public IPs.

  • Troubleshooting with dig, curl, mtr and tcpdump, and understanding what internet egress costs.

Also required

  • Production experience on at least two of Google Cloud, AWS and Alibaba Cloud, and willingness to learn the third quickly.

  • Terraform or Pulumi in production, plus scripting in Bash and in Python or Go.

  • A track record of cutting a cloud bill with data, through rightsizing, cleanup or commitments.

  • A security-first habit with production credentials, and clear written communication.

Nice to have

  • Running blockchain nodes in production, such as CometBFT validators and sentries, EVM archive or RPC nodes, and snapshot pipelines.

  • Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and Zero Trust at scale.

  • Alibaba Cloud on the international site, including its billing and support model.

  • Confidential computing (Intel TDX) and GPU workloads.

  • CKA or CKS certification, a FinOps certification, or experience moving a team between CI systems, such as Jenkins to GitHub Actions.

  • Go or Rust, enough to read and patch the services you operate.

What we offer

  • Purpose: The opportunity to contribute to making AI a public good

  • Growth: A self-directed environment where you can take initiative to shape your role and career

  • Compensation: Market-competitive compensation including, for most roles, exposure to pre-launch tokens

In addition, 0G Labs is committed to the health and well being of all of our team members. To that end, we provide reimbursements towards a holistic set of experiences and courses:

  • Core self: Transcendental Meditation

  • Mind: Landmark Education

  • Emotion: Art of Communication

  • Presence: Speech Coach

  • Body: Fitness, gym and exercise memberships/classes

jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

 

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. You will govern our hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, standardize backend data patterns across DynamoDB, relational, and analytical data stores, and ensure our core ad scoring pipelines remain resilient under massive load.

Afstudeeropdracht: Ontwerp een innovatief product voor de groei van 12Build!

Over 12Build

12Build is een SaaS-platform dat bouwbedrijven met elkaar verbindt en zo de samenwerking in de bouw makkelijker en transparanter maakt. We bestaan bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds hard. We hebben meer dan 90 collega’s op kantoren in Nijverdal en Zwolle. Ons platform wordt dagelijks gebruikt in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken, en we willen heel Europa veroveren. Met zo’n snelle groei liggen er veel vragen klaar waar nog niemand goed antwoord op heeft. Daar zoeken we jou voor.

De opdracht

We geven je geen dichtgetimmerde opdracht. Je gaat samen met Ed, je begeleider vanuit 12Build, uitzoeken welke uitdaging het beste past bij jouw opleiding en interesses. Het eindresultaat ligt wel vast: je levert een innovatief product op dat 12Build echt kan gebruiken. Dat kan een concept zijn, een tool, een strategie, een prototype of een nieuw proces, zolang het werkt en waarde oplevert.

Ontwerpvraag (startpunt):

Welk innovatief product kan 12Build ontwikkelen om sneller en slimmer te groeien in de internationale markt, en hoe ziet dat product eruit Samen maak je deze vraag in de eerste weken concreet. Mogelijke richtingen:

• AI en kennisdeling: hoe zetten we AI in om klanten en gebruikers te helpen, bijvoorbeeld met cursussen of leercontent in de 12Build Academy?.

• Groei en leadgeneratie: hoe trekken we meer nieuwe klanten aan en volgen we leads slimmer op, bijvoorbeeld met lead scoring of automatisering?.

• Self-service: hoe zorgen we dat gebruikers zelf de weg vinden op het platform en sneller een betalend account nemen?.

• Internationale groei: hoe pakken we een nieuwe markt aan en wat werkt in Nederland wel of juist niet in Duitsland of Denemarken?.

• Klantbeleving en data: hoe halen we meer uit klantdata, reviews en feedback om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren?.

• Jouw eigen idee: zie je een kans die hier niet tussen staat? Dan horen we dat graag..

Wat lever je op?

• Een onderzoek naar het probleem en de kansen, met input van collega’s, klanten of de markt;.

• Een uitgewerkt en getest product, concept of prototype;.

• Een advies over hoe 12Build het product kan invoeren, zodat het na je stage gewoon verder gebruikt wordt..

Maud over haar stage bij 12Build:

“12Build is voor mij een plek waar ik mezelf kan en mag ontwikkelen. Ik voel me vanaf het eerste moment welkom in een super leuk team. Er is fijne begeleiding, ruimte om vragen te stellen en feedback te geven/ontvangen. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.”

Wie is 12Build?
12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren.


Wie zoeken we?

• Een hbo- of wo-student die gaat afstuderen in bijvoorbeeld marketing, bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, business innovation, communicatie, AI of een vergelijkbare studie;.

• Iemand die zelf ideeën aandraagt en het leuk vindt om iets nieuws neer te zetten;.

• Iemand die beschikbaar is vanaf februari 2027, voor de duur van je afstudeerperiode;.

• Iemand die Nederlands spreekt. Duits of Engels is een pluspunt..

Wat bieden we?

• Een stagevergoeding;.

• Een eigen opdracht met echte impact in een internationaal en snelgroeiend bedrijf;.

• Begeleiding door een ervaren collega en een team van zeven marketeers;.

• Een platte organisatie waarin jouw ideeën gehoord worden;.

• Thuis en op kantoor werken, een relaxruimte met pooltafel, tafeltennis en FIFA, en geregeld uitjes en teamdagen..

Interesse?

jobs.description:
About us

Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope.

The role

We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. The hard part is making it trustworthy enough for clinical use: patient data that stays safe, an audit trail that holds up for years, and a system that recovers when something breaks. You'll own all of it, working closely with the founders and our CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the platform end to end: backend, data, infrastructure and security.

  • Get it ready for clinical use, and keep it reliable as we grow.

  • Build identity, access and data handling that clinics and auditors can trust.

  • Make the architecture calls: what to build now, what to defer, what to cut.

  • Set the engineering standard and help hire the team that follows.

What you bring

  • Platforms you've built and run. You've built backend platforms from scratch and run them in production, through outages, data incidents, migrations and growth.

  • Database depth. You know what happens under the query: indexing, locking, transactions, replication, zero-downtime schema changes, and backups you've actually restored.

  • Security by default. Authentication and authorisation, tenant isolation, secrets, audit logging. You think about how a system gets attacked before it ships.

  • Identity done properly. Identity providers, sessions and tokens, roles and permissions, onboarding and offboarding.

  • Infrastructure. Infrastructure as code, containers, Linux, networking and cloud are everyday tools for you.

  • Beyond the backend. The backend is your home, but when the product needs it, you read and change the app yourself.

  • Systematic troubleshooting. You reproduce first and fix root causes. You work from evidence like logs, traces, metrics and query plans, and you stay calm when production breaks.

  • AI-native engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You give them good context, split work into reviewable steps, and stand behind every line you ship.

  • Ownership. You help shape the roadmap, push back on weak ideas, set your own priorities and raise problems early. Nobody has to chase you. Strong opinions, held with evidence and open to revision.

  • Range. You've worked across several companies, stacks or environments. How you work counts far more than how many years you've done it.

Nice to have

  • Regulated environments with audits: medical devices, health, finance.

  • Serving ML models in production.

What we offer

  • Ownership from day one. As a founding engineer, you're part of the company through our virtual share option plan (VSOP).

  • You grow with us. As the company grows, your role grows with it.

  • Real influence. You decide how we build software, and you shape the engineering team we build.

  • A competitive salary.

  • A product that matters: a medical device for real clinics, built together with clinicians and lab staff.

  • Flexible hours and office days. We work from Berlin and meet in person regularly, up to several days a week. This isn't a fully remote role.

  • English is our working language. German isn't required.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I

jobs.description:
La mission de Finary

Notre mission : rendre le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Le bon conseil financier a toujours existé, mais il était réservé à ceux qui dépassaient un certain seuil de patrimoine. Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun.

Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et plus d'un million de personnes nous confient aujourd'hui leur vie financière. Nous lançons des produits de pointe avec une touche de plaisir, et nous sommes exigeants sur l'expérience, la performance et la simplicité.

 

Pourquoi maintenant ?

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous croyons en un monde où investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour accélérer, nous avons levé 40M€ auprès de Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise).

En juillet 2026, l'AMF nous a accordé l'agrément MiCA, qui s'ajoute à notre agrément d'Entreprise d'Investissement : nous sommes l'une des très rares plateformes françaises à détenir les deux, avec actions, ETF et crypto réunis sur une seule plateforme régulée, au moment même où l'Europe se consolide autour des acteurs agréés. Il n'y a jamais eu de meilleur moment pour nous rejoindre.

 

Ce que nous offrons

Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment.

Nous recrutons des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants, des personnes dont les idées transforment notre produit autant que notre façon de travailler et de penser. Notre culture est directe et transparente : on se challenge ouvertement, puis on s'aligne et on exécute. Et sur l'IA, pas de demi-mesure : c'est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie et un vrai critère chez nous. Chacun a repensé sa manière de travailler autour d'elle. Si c'est déjà une seconde nature pour vous, vous trouverez ici des gens qui repoussent cette frontière chaque jour.

Découvrez nos valeurs ici.

---

LE POSTE

Finary construit la banque privée de la génération internet. Notre chaîne YouTube est la première chaîne de finances personnelles en France : 880 000 abonné·es et 5 à 10 millions de vues par mois, entièrement produite en interne par une équipe qui traite le contenu comme un produit, c’est-à-dire mesuré, itéré, conçu avec méthode.

Tu prends en charge tout ce qui s’écrit chez Finary Media, de bout en bout : recherche, script, packaging, vérification des faits, livraison. Les mots t’appartiennent, de la première idée au montage final.

Tes deux terrains de jeu principaux :

  • La chaîne YouTube Finary. Des vidéos longues qui mêlent storytelling, économie et investissement, regardées par des centaines de milliers de personnes. Ton point de repère : nos meilleures vidéos dépassent le million de vues.

  • Finary One. Le contenu de notre offre de gestion de patrimoine, destiné à des investisseur·ses averti·es disposant de plus d’un million d’euros de patrimoine. C’est l’écriture aux enjeux les plus élevés chez Finary : moins de vues, mais des conséquences bien plus importantes.

Tu écris aussi pour tous les formats qui gravitent autour : la préparation du podcast Finary Talk, et tout ce qui a besoin de mots. Si c’est écrit et que ça compte, c’est pour toi.

Deux éléments distinguent ce poste de tout autre métier de scénariste :

  • Tu passes devant la caméra. Tu présentes toi-même tes scripts. Ce n’est pas une option, cela fait partie du métier ici.

  • Tu travailles nativement avec l’IA. Notre système de production repose sur des workflows LLM, des skills sur mesure et de l’automatisation. Tu ne te contenteras pas d’utiliser ces outils, tu construiras les tiens. La personne idéale pour ce poste a déjà construit des choses : prompts, agents, bases de connaissances, petits scripts.

À QUOI RESSEMBLE LA RÉUSSITE

  • Une de tes vidéos dépasse le million de vues dans tes trois premiers mois

  • À partir du troisième mois, ton contenu Finary One génère 100 M€ d’encours prospects chaque mois

  • 90 % de tes scripts sont validés en un seul tour de relecture, et tes délais de production baissent

TU ES FAIT·E POUR CE POSTE SI TU AS

  • Une maîtrise experte de l’investissement et des finances personnelles : tu peux aller en profondeur, sans notes, sur le private equity, l’immobilier, les enveloppes fiscales et la structuration patrimoniale

  • Une expérience d’écriture éprouvée face à un vrai public (YouTube, presse, newsletter, blog), avec des résultats à montrer

  • Une rigueur factuelle sans faille : aucune erreur de données, de chiffres ou de concepts, jamais

  • La concision comme réflexe, à l’écrit comme à l’oral

  • Une autonomie totale : tu gères ton propre système, tu tiens tes délais, et personne n’a besoin de te relancer

  • Une pratique native de l’IA : tu construis avec les LLM et l’automatisation parce que c’est ta façon de penser

  • De l’aisance face caméra, ou l’envie d’y arriver vite

LES PLUS

  • Tu as écrit pour des chaînes YouTube performantes, ou tu as la tienne

  • Un parcours en finance, en gestion d’actifs ou dans la fintech

  • Tu as mené seul·e un petit projet de code, une skill Claude ou un pipeline d’automatisation

Entretiens

Les entretiens avec les candidat·es francophones se déroulent en français. En tant qu’entreprise internationale, nous attendons un niveau d’anglais professionnel, que nous évaluons lors de l’entretien de présélection.

About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.

jobs.description:

Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".

Notre activité Strategy accompagne les dirigeants et investisseurs dans la résolution de problématiques complexes. Sa valeur ajoutée est de proposer des solutions réalistes et quantifiées, en combinant des approches stratégiques et opérationnelles. Afin d’accompagner sa forte croissance, nous recherchons actuellement des Senior Consultants et Consultantes (3 à 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle hors stage). L’activité Strategy compte aujourd’hui plus de 150 collaborateurs en Europe, issus des cabinets de conseils ou des entreprises.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Rejoindre l’équipe Strategy c’est prendre part à l’aventure entrepreneuriale du cabinet, en ayant un rôle essentiel dans le développement de l’activité. Pour maximiser notre impact chez les clients, nous adoptons des cycles de travail courts grâce à des sprints successifs. Cela favorise la rotation des équipes et accélère l'apprentissage. De plus, un programme de formation complet et un mentorat assuré par des collaborateurs(trices) plus expérimenté(e)s, permet à nos consultant(e)s de développer et approfondir rapidement les compétences du métier. Notre large portefeuille de clients vous permettra également de découvrir de nombreux secteurs d’activité et des contextes d’entreprises variés.

En nous rejoignant vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes d’intervention suivants :

‘Deal Strategy & Exécution’ : Dans le cadre d’une transaction, en préparation ('pre-deal’) ou en exécution (‘post-deal’), vous accompagnerez des vendeurs comme des acheteurs durant tout le processus.

En préparation du deal :

  • Définition de l’Equity Story (rationnel de l’opération et stratégie de développement)

  • Evaluation des potentielles synergies issues d’un rapprochement

  • Plan de séparation (‘Carve-out’)

Lors de l’exécution du deal :

  • Préparation de plan d’intégration (‘PMI’) et définition de la stratégie et des actions nécessaires pour garantir la continuité de l’activité ('Day 1 readiness’)

  • Mise en œuvre de plan de synergies

  • Animation et pilotage de la performance

‘Corporate Strategy & Business transformation’ : Vous participerez à la construction et à la mise en œuvre de plans stratégiques et de programmes de transformation, avec notamment :

  • Construction de plans stratégiques : plan de transformation, plan de création de valeur, repositionnement stratégique, définition de solutions et offres innovantes

  • Conception de programmes d’excellence commerciale et de développement du revenu, de nouveaux business models, de plan marketing, de plan de performance des ventes et d’amélioration de la relation client

  • Définition de nouveaux business models et innovation, de plan marketing, de plan de performance des ventes et d’amélioration de la relation client

  • Conception de projets d’excellence opérationnelle d’amélioration des performances (manufacturing, supply chain, etc.)

  • Conception de programmes de transformation digitale ou technologique

  • Mise en place des feuilles de route d’un Business Plan

  • Accompagnement des entreprises dans leurs enjeux liés aux sujets ESG

‘Turnaround & Operational Restructuring’ : Dans des contextes de sous-performance ou de crise, vous participerez à la construction et mise en œuvre de plans de retournement, avec notamment :

  • Construction et mise en œuvre de plans de retournement, avec si nécessaire la rationalisation de l'empreinte industrielle et des réseaux de distribution, la refonte de l’organisation et l’optimisation du Besoin en Fonds de Roulement

  • Mise en place et pilotage de cellules dédiées (« CRO Office ») avec notamment la construction de plans stratégiques dans des contextes de sous-performance,

  • Reprise en main de filiales ou d'activités déficitaires

En tant que Senior Consultant(e), vous serez le/la référent(e) d’un ou plusieurs chantiers sur vos missions. Vous vous verrez confier la responsabilité de l’avancement des analyses et des rapports. Vous serrez en contact direct avec vos clients dans le cadre des ateliers et des comités de pilotage.   • Une expérience opérationnelle en entreprise dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines opérationnels et / ou financiers

Vous êtes doté(e) de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux(se), dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère serait un plus). jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

You will own the functional architecture and performance of the propellant feed system for a storable bipropellant propulsion system (MON3-MMH system). You will be responsible for ensuring the feed system delivers propellants to the thrusters within required specifications across the full mission envelope — from ground fill through operation, and recovery.

Role Overview

System Architecture

  • Define and maintain the functional architecture of the feed system including propellant tanks, lines, valves, filters, thrusters and instrumentation.

  • Perform system-level sizing, sensitivity analyses and functional simulations

System Development

  • Define functional requirements for subsystems based on propellant system analyses

  • Identify key verification and validation steps required at the system and subsystem level to demonstrate compliance with specification

Modeling & Analysis

  • Develop and maintain fluid system models (steady-state and transient) to predict pressure drop, flow rates, water hammer, thruster cross-coupling, and priming behavior.

  • Verify compliance between system nominal and off-nominal operation with subsystem operational domains (such as thruster envelope).

  • Analyze failure modes (leakage, contamination, cavitation, fluid hammer) and define mitigation strategies and design margins.

Verification & Test

  • Lead functional and performance verification: cold-flow, functional and hot-fire tests from component to assembly level .

  • Correlate test data against predictive models and update margins/requirements accordingly.

Integration Support

  • Support integration, qualification, and operations reviews (design reviews, FMEA, test readiness reviews).

You report directly to the Global Fleet Manager and collaborate closely with stakeholders across Operations, Finance, and IT.

The first months are critical for success.
You start by taking over existing processes and ensuring continuity in reporting. From there, you progressively improve, automate, and professionalize data and dashboards.

What will you do?

You make the difference by making data usable — not just visible.

Requirements

Your profile

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements.

  • Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

  • Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

Communications & Data Handling

  • Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts.

  • Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

  • Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints.

  • Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration & Interface Management

  • Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

  • Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

  • Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification & Validation

  • Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

  • Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

  • Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

  • Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

  • Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

  • Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

  • Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

  • Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.

  • +7 years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Electronic and embedded system architectures

    • Communication and data handling principles

    • System integration and interface management

  • Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development.

  • Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems.

  • Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS).

  • Experience with HIL testing, simulation environments, or digital engineering tools.

  • Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.

  • Experience working in international or multi-stakeholder engineering teams.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why Deployment Strategists are our customers' #1 go-to person

We aim to solve the most complex problems in sales engineering and work closely with customers in mapping out their ideal inbound process. You will dive into our enterprise customers processes to help deploy Atira agents with our FDEs and face their most intricate challenges. You are the go-to person inside our largest partners for anything project management and use case scoping related, and this from the point where you demo our product for the first time up until multi-annual partnership commercial negotiations.
Trust and use case insights are your two most valuable resources you get from customers and what you bring back home will directly shape our core platform in the near future - this requires a strong taste when it comes to how a software product is shaped and a strong opinion on what is needed to maximize customer satisfaction. Beyond that, our Deployment Strategists think beyond a single customer and are essential in figuring out the concrete steps to scale to our next 100 customers by accelerating onboarding processes and increasing customer satisfaction.

What you will do

  • Own the customer end-to-end together with an FDE Tech Lead. From kickoff to renewal, you are on the hook. You run SteerCos, scope deployments, drive onboarding, and decide what gets built next.

  • Scope the agents that work best for a customer You go deep on each customer's technical sales process, understanding it in all it’s details. You bring home whatever solves their problems and conceptualize this across all of your customers

  • Decide what scales and what doesn't. You sit at the boundary between customer work and the core platform. You translate customer behavior into product feedback features and will need to be opinionated on product / our agents

  • Identify, elevate and partner with end users as well as C-Level. You support the internal owner and help scope the long term growth plan.

  • Tell the story. You speak at industry events, co-author case studies, and represent Atira in front of customer executives and prospects. The GTM motion is built around the stories you create

What we are looking for

Ownership, drive, structured thinking, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity and open ended problems. You take problems personally, decide in the absence of a clear roadmap, and own the outcome including the downside.

Your profile

  • Demonstrated ownership and initiative: a company you started, a leading role in a team or larger project

  • 3+ Years customer facing experience working with both end users and C-Level

  • You thrive in customer-facing situations: high-stakes conversations with executives energize you, you push back when needed, and you walk out with a clear next step

  • You’ve optimized your AI tooling: you’ve invested heavily in building the skills and context layer to get the maximum out of your day

  • Relevant coding or strong analytical experience

  • Full working proficiency in both German and English

  • Frontend and app-building / Feature taste

  • Occasional on-site travel per customer requirements; 20-40% overall (DACH primarily, occasionally international)

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and comapny as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers: work with people who have built and shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale before, and the chance to learn directly from them

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary & equity package and additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and company dinners

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like after a few months

  • You independently run enterprise deployments end-to-end, from kickoff to production

  • Customers rely on you as their primary contact and trust your judgment

  • Your learnings have shaped core platform features and the playbook for the customers who come after you
